commentary_title: Low utilisation to impact Handy rates
commentary_summary: The utilisation of Handysize vessels declined marginally from 92.8% to 92.7% WoW. Moreover, the decline has been steeper compared to 93.3%, a month ago | Meanwhile,there has been a surge in vessels waiting to load in the East, particularly at Chinese ports to load fertilisers with destinations to Indonesia, Australia and Malaysia. Also, there has been some increase in Handysize vessels waiting to load iron ore at Indian ports for destinations to the Middle East | The laden and ballast tonnage at anchor in the Atlantic increased also because vessel movement was disrupted after the port of Baltimore was forced to shut down when the Fancis Scott Key Bridge, hit by a vessel, collapsed. | The global ballast speed was 9.3 knots on average last week, lower by as much as 0.4 knot in the same period last year.
